messages:
jen-support: FYI customer ACME (acct: acme-42) reports billing problem after mid-cycle downgrade. They were on Large -> Small on 2025-11-08, invoice INV-2025-11-08-9001 charged full month, card declined on follow-up retry. They want a partial refund/credit for unused days and a credit note for VAT purposes. Ticket #4521. Any standard playbook? :thinking:
dan-finance: Need invoice ID (we have INV-2025-11-08-9001), charge id, customer VAT country (they're in IE), and PO number. Do we have PO on file? If not, we usually issue a credit note referencing the invoice and adjust VAT accordingly.
ajenda: quick note: for EU VAT we need the credit note to mirror VAT lines exactly, and reference original invoice. If it's a refund to card we also need the transaction id and bank ledger entry.
liam-sales: client insists on a refund to card (company policy), but original card is now declined. They provided a new card but asked to not re-attempt charge. They also want the PO (PO-ACME-2025-09) referenced on paperwork.
jen-support: Repro steps I used to confirm billing double-charge when they switched plans mid-cycle:
```
# repro
POST /v1/billing/change-plan
payload: {"account_id":"acme-42","from_plan":"large","to_plan":"small","effective_date":"2025-11-08T03:00:00Z"}
# server responded 202 then async job created charge for pro-rated downgrade but also left monthly invoice untouched -> double charge
```
log snippet: 
```
2025-11-08T03:01:14Z INFO billing.worker job=chgplan acct=acme-42 state=created
2025-11-08T03:01:15Z INFO billing.invoicer invoice=INV-2025-11-08-9001 status=paid amount=30000 cents
2025-11-08T03:01:16Z WARN billing.adjust prorate_calc=0.58 created_charge=ch_5G7b... attempted_refund=null
```
dan-finance: Thanks, Jen. For the finance playbook:
- If card refund possible: issue refund against charge id (ch_5G7b...) and create Credit Note CN-2025-11-08-002 referencing INV-2025-11-08-9001.
- If card declined: create credit note for the prorated amount and offer either an applied credit (to next invoice) or manual bank refund (ACH) once they provide bank details. Document PO on the credit note.
- VAT: credit note must have negative VAT lines identical to invoice.

alejandra-accounts: I'll prepare the credit note template. Proration calc I used (for transparency):
```
prorated_amount = monthly_price * (remaining_days / total_days)
example: monthly_price = 300.00 EUR, remaining_days = 18, total_days = 30 -> prorated_amount = 300 * 0.6 = 180.00 EUR
VAT (23%) -> 41.40 EUR -> total credit = 221.40 EUR
```
alejandra-accounts: If they want cash refund to new card, we need: charge id to refund OR process an outbound transfer (ACH) and reconcile once cleared. PO must be on CN metadata (PO-ACME-2025-09).

liam-sales: Is there a temporary workaround so ACME can close their compliance loop? They need a credit note PDF with PO and VAT immediately, they don't need funds refunded right away.
dan-finance: Yes—issue CN, send PDF to client, mark as unapplied credit in system. That satisfies PO/VAT reconciliation. We can process cash refund after card issues resolved.

billing-bot: Created BLG-987 (billing engineering) from thread, linked INV-2025-11-08-9001 and CN draft CN-2025-11-08-002.

jen-support: Next actions: (1) Alejandra to generate CN draft with PO and VAT lines today; (2) Dan to confirm refund path if client requests card refund later; (3) Billing eng to investigate downgrade job double-charge (BLG-987). I'll update ticket #4521 and inform ACME that CN PDF will be sent within 24h. :white_check_mark:
